title: Ethiopian-Style Vegan Stew
description: A flavorful and spicy vegan stew inspired by the flavors of Ethiopia, made with a variety of vegetables and a rich wot sauce.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic and cook until softened.
Add carrots and potatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Add tomato paste and berbere spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over injera or with rice.
